lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns and sign-in hints were helpful, generating multiple winning tests; home wait info, home notifications, and sign-in redesigns also proved helpful by yielding winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, finish hints, choose_path layouts, and finish redesigns consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated unexpected winning layout redesigns, hints, and wait info changes.

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in step after adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the adoption certificate screen so users finish pet creation before signing in.
candidates.why: High early drop-off suggests users convert better when fully invested in their custom pet before being prompted to create or access an account.

candidates.title: Desktop overlay controls intro screen insertion
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop controls intro screen after loading to demonstrate how to summon, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Support mail showed 3 separate emails detailing confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.

new_overlay_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_overlay_intro.body: Learn how to move, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet anytime.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Two-column layout redesign for sign-in screen
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a side-by-side two-column layout separating sign-in options from pet account benefits.
candidates.why: Sign-in layout redesigns have yielded winning tests in prior rounds, and sign-in drop-off remains a key funnel bottleneck.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to keep your desktop companion synced across restarts.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout while preserving its function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step has low drop-off; layout redesigns require significant dev effort with modest historic lift.

candidates.title: Interactive pet personality selector screen insertion
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive pet personality selection screen right after picking a friend to customize pet behavior.
candidates.why: Adding engaging pet customization steps during adoption increases user attachment and completion rates across the adoption flow.

new_pet_trait.headline: Select Pet Personality
new_pet_trait.body: Choose whether your pet is energetic, relaxed, or playful on your desktop.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Account recovery guarantee hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in connects your current pet safely to your account.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Log in with your primary account to automatically bind and restore your pet data across devices.

guard.reason: Adding an informative account sync hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and history shows sign-in hints reliably boost conversion at low cost.

candidates.title: Desktop tip carousel component on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive tip carousel component on the waiting screen sharing quick desktop interaction shortcuts while loading.
candidates.why: Wait info changes on the home step have yielded past test wins, helping educate users before desktop spawn.

components.text: Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open companion settings or hide it temporarily.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Wait info changes have proven positive track record during long home load times, but component building has cost.

candidates.title: Compact layout redesign for photo upload screen
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen into a compact layout with streamlined controls for uploading custom images.
candidates.why: Adoption layout redesigns are proven to generate winning tests and reduce hesitation during pet customization.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Add a photo to personalize your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while maintaining its job is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high retention; single past layout test showed negative lift with thin evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop readiness alert notification on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable a system readiness alert notification switch on the waiting screen to inform users when their pet spawns.
candidates.why: Home notifications have provided winning tests previously, preventing drop-offs when desktop initialization takes time.

waiting.hint: We will alert you as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding notification readiness settings to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications consistently yield winning tests to keep users engaged during desktop load times.

candidates.title: Starter path preview cards on story screen
candidates.change: Add visual choice card components to the initial story screen highlighting instant starter perks for each path.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has an 83.1% conversion rate; early path motivation encourages users to progress faster.

components.text: Explore unique path bonuses and instant desktop accessories.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions path bonuses and desktop accessories, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Tray navigation control hint on home intro screen
candidates.change: Add a guidance hint on the home intro screen clarifying how to locate and control the pet via the system tray.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding how to locate, talk to, or manage the pet.

home_intro.hint: Find your pet's tray icon near your desktop clock to access controls, change settings, or summon your pet.

guard.reason: Adding guidance hints to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step is the biggest funnel bottleneck with direct support complaints; simple hint offers strong lift potential at low cost.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for single-test change kinds (choose_path hint, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns, sign-in hints, sign-in redesigns, home wait info, and home notifications proved helpful by yielding winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), as well as adding new screens on finish (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, finish hints, and choose_path layouts consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated several unexpected winning redesigns, hints, and wait info changes.
